status: FINAL rule, confirmed by Quinn (Oct 9 2026, afternoon PT). Written BEFORE any final run of run_drill.R; the script reads every parameter from this file and records its SHA-256.
reason_for_change: The CEO viewed the app and asked for deeper drilling: stopping at the overtime split misses the large non-overtime group (72% of staff), and a 1.5x rate floor can filter out larger groups at lower lift whose absolute effect on company attrition is bigger.

rule2_impact.impact_points_formula: excess / 1470 (15 people is about 1 point of company-wide attrition)
rule2_impact.note: replaces the 1.5x lift floor as the main effect test

rule4_heldout.if_test_n_below_min: supported on the full data, test too small (not cleared)

rule5_stability.wording: Branch-aware: across 500 bootstrap refits, each of the group's defining variables must appear as a primary split inside its own branch (refits fit on that branch's rows separately: overtime-only rows for overtime groups, non-overtime-only rows for non-overtime groups) at a similar cut. For groups whose first split is on the whole company, the old nodes 1-3 rule applies (refits on all rows, depth 3).
rule5_stability.similar_cut: the refit's cut falls within +/- 0.10 of the group's cut measured as the share of the branch's employees below the cut; for categorical variables the same variable being split counts

old_rule.test: n >= 30 and test rate > test-set rate
old_rule.stability: every defining variable (including OverTime) a primary split at nodes 1-3 of depth-3 company-wide refits, any cut, > 50% of refits

reported_not_gating.parent_branch: rate, lift, excess and impact are also reported against the parent branch (overtime 30.5% or non-overtime 10.4%; company for company-wide groups); the pass/fail gates use the company average as Quinn confirmed

stability_sensitivity.purpose: reported next to rule 5, never a pass condition for 'qualifying'; groups passing rules 1-4 and this check are labelled 'supported, unstable under 1-SE pruning' and are also drilled further
stability_sensitivity.refit: bootstrap refits within the branch (same rows as rule 5), minbucket 100, maxdepth 3, cp 0.005, no cross-validation, no pruning

parent_branch_view.purpose: judge each group against its parent branch (overtime 30.5%, no overtime 10.4%, company for company-wide groups) as well as the company average
parent_branch_view.gates: n >= 100 and leavers >= 24; excess vs parent >= 15 people; rate / parent rate >= 1.25 and Wilson lower end > parent rate; test n >= 30 and test rate > the parent branch's test-set rate; then the same rule-5 stability
parent_branch_view.label: clear against its own branch
parent_branch_view.status: reported; the company-average gates remain the qualifying rule

training_only_cuts: Every tree and every cut point (tree splits, quantile grids, the hand-built career-stage groups) is derived on the 70% training split only and evaluated untouched on the 30% test set. Size, impact, Wilson and stability use full-data counts.

trees.method: anova on 0/1 attrition (Gini-equivalent, Brier CV risk)
trees.depth_note: no hard cap in practice: minbucket and minsplit end growth
trees.enumerate: every non-root node of the grown (cp 0.001) tree, flagged if also in the 1-SE pruned tree

grid.discrete_rule: numeric variables with at most 6 distinct training values use every value boundary as a cut
grid.sides: both sides of every cut are tested

drill.rule: every tree node and every qualifying group with >= 100 employees is examined: all single-split children (every predictor, grid cuts from training rows in that node) are tested; qualifying children are drilled in turn
drill.stopping_rule: no remaining node with >= 100 employees yields a child that qualifies
drill.drilled_further: every tree node with >= 100 employees, plus every group that passes rules 1-5, or rules 1-4 with the unpruned stability check, or the parent-branch gates with stability, plus every one-condition group inside a branch that passes the parent-branch gates 1-4

sensitive_handling: tested and counted, shown as descriptive only, never headlined, never in qualifying.csv, never drilled

overlap.note: impacts are never added across overlapping groups; the union is counted once

null_calibration.shuffle: Attrition labels permuted within the training rows and within the test rows (keeps both rates)
null_calibration.search: same search and rules; trees and cuts re-derived on the shuffled training rows
null_calibration.note: stability in shuffles uses 100 refits per scope (not 500) to keep run time reasonable; only groups that pass rules 1-4 need it
report: mean and 95th percentile of groups passing rules 1-5
share of shuffles with at least one passing group
mean share of tested groups passing

labels.career_stage: experience, tenure, job level and pay are one correlated cluster; reported as one career-stage picture

amendment: Amended at 2026-10-09 15:15:07 PDT (before any final run). Quinn's five gates are unchanged. Added, as reported-not-gating items: (1) a stability sensitivity with unpruned refits, because a first smoke test showed that 1-SE pruning sends about 3 in 4 refits inside the no-overtime branch to the root, which caps any group's stability share well below 50%; (2) the parent-branch view (gates against the parent branch rate) next to the company-average rule; (3) a safety cap of 6 defining conditions on drilling. Drilling every group that passes the parent-branch gates (before stability) cascaded to hundreds of thousands of groups, so groups chosen for drilling only by those gates are drilled while they have a single defining condition inside their branch. Final edit at 2026-10-09 15:28:43 PDT: made the sensitivity-refit settings and the storage floor explicit parameters; no rule changed.

reporting.note: groups with fewer than 50 people are counted as tested but not stored in candidates_all.csv
